contract.name: Tool Scope Resolution Contract
contract.description: 定义 Scope 如何从 Invocation Context 解析

withScopeManager.logic: ScopeManager.Evaluate with SubjectType=SubjectTool, SubjectID=tool.ID, CharacterID/ConversationID/ExtensionID from Invocation Context

withoutScopeManager.logic: Fallback: tool.Scope.Type check → global=pass, character=match ID, conversation=match ID, internal=pass, else scope_denied

contract.note: ScopeManager evaluates via ScopeEvaluator + relationChecker; model cannot forge scope
